primary_candidate: bridge: fixed lambda=Nt/(Ns+Nt), target-median DIR, exact pooled-N reference, external D
backup: unchanged target-only R3; it is a baseline, not an independently invented R4 method
history: R4-D001c six cases x64 is development. R2/R3/C2 old confirmations keep their old labels and are not R4 inputs. This is the sole R4 confirmation; no reserved retry and no global historical confidence claim. No optional sample extension, seed reroll, scenario deletion or refreeze on result.
independence: Separate SeedSequence child streams for Z,Cs,Ct,references. Each repeat regenerates both banks and whole Z. Case1 and8 share pair_id to compare allocations on common Z; independent rep indices remain the units for their paired contrast. All core contrasts are equal-weight averages over six fixed cases within rep; no gene-level pseudo-replication.
precision_basis: DEV paired SD bridge-target .410/.275/.212/.192/.100 across legal cases. At n512 pointwise MCSE roughly .44-1.81pp; finite simultaneous betting intervals are wider and are the reporting intervals. DEV cost268.44s/384 at8workers; estimated45-65min for5120 at10workers. Fixed512 also gives useful finite FDR upper endpoints near a .5-1pct empirical FDR; not guaranteed decisive. Sample count is fixed now and will not increase to obtain a favorable interval.
interval_method: Frozen R3 fixed-fraction betting inversion, whole-family metric in[0,1] or paired difference[-1,1], Bonferroni cap160 with alpha.025;9x10 FDR,5x7 nonnull Power differences,5 core differences,3 allocation differences=133. Intervals concern this design only. Theory and MC evidence remain separate.
validity_gate: Complete T1-T3 chain and implementation audit. Empirical support flag only if all9 within-bound primary bridge FDR upper endpoints<=.05. If not, label finite evidence unresolved/contradictory as appropriate; do not change nominal q or tune to truth.
usefulness_rules: Report all cases and equal-weight core. Local efficiency evidence if bridge-minus-target lower>0 at a registered case with valid premise; no claim of a uniform winner. For an overall-advantage claim require core lower>0 AND all legal nonnull per-case lower>=-.02 (guard about one signed discovery in sparse G256 design). Known wide-D loss is retained and may defeat that stronger claim. No +3pp target. Strong comparisons alone cannot override missing validity assumptions.
boundary_rule: Case9 has underestimated external D; retain its FDR/Power but exclude it explicitly from within-bound validity gate and core because that is its predeclared role. It cannot be repaired with diagnostic true delta. Case3 is legal but loose and remains in core.
information_tracks: Target-source differences change calibration information. Bridge-target and bridge-ordinary share the same available Cs,Ct,D; target ignores optional Cs/D. Strong target and bound-pool are both reported. Fixed total allocation pair1/8 has36 blocks but different target share; not an algorithm improvement at identical information.
stop: Attempt10x512 once; all failed/nonconverged records retained. Audit and fixed first-rep replays after completion. No algorithm modifications during confirmation. Complete report even if bridge is not uniformly preferable; this is not permission to declare all scientific goals successful.
